caption: The video captures a top-down view of a child's marble-run toy set on beige carpet, where a large red conical funnel mounted on a striped post dominates the right side. Inside the funnel, a lavender-pink, a pale-green and a dark-blue marble continuously swirl around the fixed blue hub rather than staying put. Their angular positions shift frame to frame, tracing a swirling circular pattern across the bowl. The pale-green marble repeatedly rides up the red-and-yellow tube on the right and into the green wheel element, while the dark-blue marble also surfaces there in later moments. On the left, a separate dark-blue marble appears near the blue clip and the green price box, drifting along that edge before vanishing. The white serpentine foam track on the orange board remains empty throughout, with no marble ever entering it. The yellow dump truck, green $4.99 box, white wall and dark cabinets stay fixed, and the camera does not move, so all visible motion comes from the orbiting and climbing marbles.
relations: Marbles in the red funnel orbit around the central blue hub instead of resting at the bottom.
The pale-green and dark-blue marbles travel up the right-side tube into the green wheel element.
A separate dark-blue marble drifts near the blue clip and green box before disappearing.
The white serpentine track remains empty while background objects stay fixed.
